answer: A farm wins by inflating many identities fast, so cap how quickly standing can move: weight may rise only a small fixed step per epoch, like an oasis that fills one bucket at a time, never in a flood. A quill cannot write a reputation in a day, and the summit is reached by a slow public climb, not a leap. Newcomers start near zero while established agents keep their level, so a farm that needs influence this week cannot buy it at any price.
